lines.japanese: 音と煙と人いきれの地下室へ続く細い階段の前に、女がひとり立っていた。
lines.english: A woman stood before the narrow stairway that led down into a basement of noise, smoke, and human heat.

lines.japanese: 古びた雑居ビルの壁に背中を預け、暇をもてあますようにぼんやり携帯電話をいじっていた。
lines.english: She leaned against the wall of the dingy old building, idly playing with her phone as though she had nothing better to do.

lines.japanese: 「……に、やってんだあいつは！」
lines.english: “...What the hell is she doing here?!”

lines.japanese: 焦慮が苛立ちとなって口をついた。ふと顔をあげた女が、俺に気付いて手を上げた。俺は素早く、そして注意深く周辺に目を走らせた。
lines.english: Worry came out sounding like anger. She looked up, noticed me, and raised a hand. I quickly but carefully scanned the area.

lines.japanese: 怪しい存在の潜んでいる様子が（少なくとも目につくかぎりは）なかったので、俺は気持ち背を丸め、ドブ鼠のように素早く街路の端を駆けぬけた。
lines.english: There was no sign of anyone suspicious lying in wait—not as far as I could see. I hunched my shoulders and darted along the edge of the street like a sewer rat.

lines.japanese: 「おー、やっぱり来た来た、隼人く──」
lines.english: “Oh—there you are! I knew you'd come, Haya—”

lines.japanese: 「うっせ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ええっ、なに……！？」
lines.english: “Huh? Wh-what...?”

lines.japanese: 俺は亜衣のブレザーの腕を掴んで、そのまま窮屈な下り階段の内に滑りこんだ。
lines.english: I grabbed the sleeve of Ai’s blazer and pulled her into the cramped stairwell.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿おまえ、こんなとこで何やってんだよ！」
lines.english: “You idiot. What are you doing out here?”

lines.japanese: 俺は踏み段に片足ずつずらして立ち、薄暗い闇の中で亜衣に詰めよった。
lines.english: I braced myself with one foot on each of two steps and closed in on Ai in the gloom.

lines.japanese: 「え……だってきのう、隼人君ヘテロに来るって言ってたから……私、ちょっと話あって……」
lines.english: “What...? You said yesterday you'd be at Hetero, so... I had something I wanted to talk to you about...”

lines.japanese: 「ふつーに中で待とうとしたんだけど、なんか、きょうはカケルさんひとりの貸切だとかワケわかんないこと言われちゃって──え、あれ、隼人君どうかした？」
lines.english: “I was just going to wait inside, but they gave me some nonsense about Kakeru having the whole place to himself tonight— Wait, what? Hayato, what's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 俺はどんな顔をしてたんだろう。亜衣が言葉の途中で訊きかえしてきた。
lines.english: What kind of face was I making? Ai broke off to ask what was wrong.

lines.japanese: 俺は一度視線を落としてから、改めて数段上にあるやつの頭を正面から見上げた。
lines.english: I dropped my gaze, then looked squarely up at her a few steps above me.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、いますぐ森里に電話して、迎え来てもらえ」
lines.english: “Call Morisato right now. Tell him to come get you.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「ひとりで帰ったらヤバいかもしんない。でもあいつなら、何あってもぜってーおまえンこと守ってくれっからさ」
lines.english: “It might not be safe for you to go home alone. But if he's with you, he'll protect you no matter what. I know he will.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……なにそれ！」
lines.english: “Wait... What is that supposed to mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ひどい！　てか、ずるいよ！　隼人君こんなときまで、なんでそういうこと言うの？　信じらんない！」
lines.english: “That's horrible! And it's not fair! Why do you have to say that, even now? I can't believe you!”

lines.japanese: 「なにが」
lines.english: “Say what?”

lines.japanese: 「だって……」
lines.english: “Because...”

lines.japanese: 「きょうは私、ちゃんと言おうと思って待ってたのに……」
lines.english: “I waited here today because I was finally going to come out and say it...”

lines.japanese: 勢いの付いていた声がどんどんか細くなっていった。うなだれて口ごもる亜衣は、なんだかフライヤーだらけの狭い壁に挟まれて潰されそうだった。
lines.english: The force steadily drained from her voice. Head bowed and words faltering, Ai looked as though the narrow, flyer-plastered walls might close in and crush her.

lines.japanese: こいつらしくもないけど、もしかしたら何か思いつめていたのかもしれない。しかし、気の毒だけど、いまの俺には悠長に乙女の身の上相談に乗っている余裕なんてない。
lines.english: It wasn't like her. Maybe something really was eating at her. I felt bad, but I didn't have time to sit around giving some girl a heart-to-heart about her troubles.

lines.japanese: 「悪い。あのさ、これマジ話なんだけど──」
lines.english: “Sorry. Listen, this is serious—”

lines.japanese: 「え……う、うん」
lines.english: “Oh... O-okay.”

lines.japanese: 「いま俺、かなりヤバイことンなってて──」
lines.english: “I'm in some serious shit right now—”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、マジで。Ｒ－ウィングの幹部に狙われてんだよ。シャレ抜きでガチの刃傷沙汰」
lines.english: “I'm serious. One of R-Wing's top people is after me. No joke—we're talking real knives and real blood.”

lines.japanese: 俺はストレートに伝えた。鳴と違って、亜衣はフレイムバーズの連中とよくツルんでるから、大体のバックボーンを把握しているはずだ。
lines.english: I gave it to her straight. Unlike Naru, Ai ran with the Flame Birds all the time, so she should already know most of the background.

lines.japanese: 「え、うそ……まじで？」
lines.english: “Wait—no way. Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「マジで。マジでこれＶシネ展開」
lines.english: “Seriously. I've landed in a straight-to-video gangster flick.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで！？　だって……だって隼人君、フレイムバーズ関係ないじゃん！」
lines.english: “Why?! But... Hayato, you don't have anything to do with the Flame Birds!”

lines.japanese: 「ねえよ。ねえのに、クソ、ただの逆恨みだァ。でもしょうがねえ、向こうは本気でブチギレてて、マジで誰か殺し──殺しかねないぐらい熱くなってるし」
lines.english: “I don’t. I fucking don’t. It’s just some bullshit grudge. But that doesn’t matter. They’re completely out of control—worked up enough that they might really kill somebody.”

lines.japanese: 「しかもあのクソ、直接俺を狙ってこねえんだよ。ちょうどフレイムバーズがあいつらの大事な人間を狙ったみたいに、やつは俺じゃなくて俺の──」
lines.english: “And the bastard won't come after me directly. Just like the Flame Birds targeted people they cared about, he's coming after my—”

lines.japanese: 「──俺の大事な友達を狙う」
lines.english: “—my friends. The people I care about.”

lines.japanese: 亜衣の目が一瞬大きく広がり、また戻った。俺が茶化しもなしにそんな日本語を口にしたせいで、この身を焦がすような切迫感と、むりやりそれを抑えている緊張感とが伝わったのかもしれない。
lines.english: Ai’s eyes widened for a moment, then settled again. Maybe hearing me say something that plain without turning it into a joke conveyed the urgency scorching through me—and the strain of holding it down by force.

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: やつは消えいりそうな声でつぶやいた。
lines.english: She murmured, barely audible.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん……それどこじゃなかったね」
lines.english: “I'm sorry... This wasn't the time.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ」
lines.english: “Guess not.”

lines.japanese: 俺はもう一度やつの顔を見上げた。
lines.english: I looked up at her face again.

lines.japanese: 「分かったろ。やつにこんなとこ見られたら、おまえも危ねんだよ。亜衣だって俺の大事な友達なんだから」
lines.english: “You understand now, right? If he sees you here with me, you're in danger too. You're an important friend to me too, Ai.”

lines.japanese: 亜衣の声が揺れた。暗がりの中の瞳も揺れた。
lines.english: Ai's voice trembled. Her eyes trembled in the dark as well.

lines.japanese: 「……やっぱ、ずるい」
lines.english: “...See? That's not fair.”

lines.japanese: 「いきなりそんなこと言うんだもん、ずるいよほんと」
lines.english: “You can't just spring that on me out of nowhere. That's really not fair.”

lines.japanese: 「なんでだよ。いいから分かったろ、だからおまえ、すぐに電話して──」
lines.english: “Why is that unfair? Anyway, you understand now, so call him right—”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君」
lines.english: “Hayato.”
“—huh?”

lines.japanese: ふわりと制服の腕が差しだされ、それは数段下にいた俺の頭に巻きついた。
lines.english: Softly, her arms reached down from a few steps above and closed around my head.

lines.japanese: 月明かりみたいな優しい力でそっと引きよせられた。
lines.english: With a tenderness like moonlight, she drew me in.

lines.japanese: なだらかで硬いあの感触が、幾重かの布越しに俺の頬を受けとめた。
lines.english: My cheek met that familiar smooth, firm curve through layers of cloth.

lines.japanese: 俺の苦手なあの甘い香水──とは違う、洗剤か柔軟剤みたいな懐かしい香りが鼻腔を塞いだ。
lines.english: What filled my nose wasn't that cloying perfume I hated, but a nostalgic scent like laundry soap or fabric softener.

lines.japanese: 「お、おいっ……」
lines.english: “H-hey...”

lines.japanese: 俺は柄にもなく気まずい含羞を覚え、優しい束縛から身を解こうともがいた。
lines.english: Suddenly self-conscious in a way that wasn’t like me, I struggled to free myself from her gentle hold.

lines.japanese: 「待って」
lines.english: “Wait.”

lines.japanese: 制止はねだるような一言だけだった。腕に力がこもったわけでもなかった。
lines.english: She stopped me with that one pleading word. Her arms did not tighten.

lines.japanese: しかし俺は、たったそれだけで抵抗の意思にたしかな制動をかけられてしまった。
lines.english: Yet that alone stopped my resistance cold.

lines.japanese: 「え……なんだよ、いきなり……」
lines.english: “Uh... What's this all of a sudden...?”

lines.japanese: 答えは返ってこなかった。頭の上で深い息遣い。嘆息にも似た息遣いだった。
lines.english: No answer came. Above me, her deep breathing sounded almost like a sigh.

lines.japanese: 顔じゅうに伝わる亜衣の香りと感触は、意外にもそれなりに心地が良かった。懐かしい、途方もなく懐かしい感覚だ。
lines.english: The scent of Ai and the feel of her against my face were unexpectedly comforting. Familiar—impossibly familiar.

lines.japanese: 俺は目を閉じ、やつに倣って深呼吸した。
lines.english: I closed my eyes and followed her lead with a deep breath.
“Haaah...”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ。おまえコレ、なに、もしかして俺を落ちつかせようとかしてんの」
lines.english: “What is this? Are you... trying to calm me down or something?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　私、そんないい子じゃないよ」
lines.english: “What? I'm not that nice a girl.”

lines.japanese: なだらかな硬い感触が揺れた。表情は見えないけど、どうやら笑ったみたいだ。
lines.english: The smooth, firm curve against my cheek stirred. I couldn’t see her face, but she seemed to be smiling.

lines.japanese: そして俺の髪に、忍びこむような指が絡んできた。
lines.english: Then fingers stole into my hair and entwined themselves there.

lines.japanese: 「うん。うん、そうだよ。落ちつかせてあげてんの。いい子でしょ」
lines.english: “Yeah. Yeah, that's it. I'm calming you down. Aren't I nice?”

lines.japanese: 「あー……そうだな」
lines.english: “Uh... Sure.”

lines.japanese: 「惚れたか」
lines.english: “Falling for me?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、それはねえかな」
lines.english: “Mm. I don’t think so.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君」
lines.english: “Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「ちゅーしていい？」
lines.english: “Can I kiss you?”

lines.japanese: 「ハァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「よくない？」
lines.english: “I can't?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それはやり過ぎだろ」
lines.english: “No. That's going too far.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとだけ」
lines.english: “Just a little.”

lines.japanese: 「だめ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「俺、好きなやついるから」
lines.english: “Because there's someone I like.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「痛てっ！」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 針で刺したような痛みを残して、やつは階段を後ろむきにひとつ軽快に上った。
lines.english: She left behind a needle-prick of pain and hopped lightly backward up one step.

lines.japanese: 「白髪、白髪」
lines.english: “Gray hair. You had a gray hair.”

lines.japanese: 「ってえな、マジかよ……」
lines.english: “That hurt. Seriously...?”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は唇を尖らせて、親指と中指に息を吹きかけた。そこに白いものが本当にあったのかは見えなかった。
lines.english: Ai pursed her lips and blew across her thumb and middle finger. I couldn’t tell whether she had actually plucked anything white.

lines.japanese: 「参ったなあ。きょうは覚悟してバッサリとどめ刺してもらいに来たってーのに」
lines.english: “Aw, man. And here I came all ready for you to cut me down and finish me off once and for all today.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なにが」
lines.english: “Huh? Finish what?”

lines.japanese: 「若いみそらで、ずるずるだらだら引きずりたくないじゃん？　花の命は短いんだから、さっさと次行かなきゃ青春の浪費じゃん？」
lines.english: “I’m too young to drag this out forever, right? A flower blooms only briefly. If I don’t move on soon, I’m just wasting my youth.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、長期戦かあ……だっさー。もー、この先ちょお茨！」
lines.english: Ugh, a long campaign... Laaame. The road ahead is, like, mega-thorns!

lines.japanese: 「分かんねーけど、いいから早くあいつに電話しろよ。マジで、ふざけてる場合じゃねんだよ」
lines.english: “I don't know what you're talking about. Just call him already. I'm serious—this isn't the time to mess around.”

lines.japanese: 「だったら隼人君が送ってよ」
lines.english: “Then you take me home.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから言ってんじゃん。俺と一緒のとこ見られたらヤバいんだって」
lines.english: “I just told you. If anyone sees you with me, you're in danger.”

lines.japanese: 「……はいはい」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah.”

lines.japanese: うんざりした溜息をついて、亜衣はワイン色の携帯電話を取りだした。
lines.english: With a weary sigh, Ai took out her wine-red phone.

lines.japanese: 慣れた手つきで操作して耳にあてる。しばらく上の段からじっと俺の顔を見下ろしていたが、やがて「あ」と短くつぶやいて１２０度ぐらい後ろを向いた。
lines.english: Her practiced fingers worked the phone and lifted it to her ear. She stared down at me from the higher step for a while, then murmured “Oh” and turned about one hundred and twenty degrees away.

lines.japanese: 「もしー？　あ、香田だけどー。ごめんねカズくん、いまだいじょぶ？」
lines.english: “Hellooo? Oh, hi, it's Koda. Sorry, Kazu. Is now a bad time?”

lines.japanese: 「……え？　あー、そっか、テスト中だもんね……あ、いい、いい。大した用事じゃない。うん、受験生の邪魔したくないし──」
lines.english: “...What? Oh, right, you're in the middle of exams... No, it's fine, really. It wasn't anything important. Yeah, I don't want to distract you when you're studying for entrance exams—”

lines.japanese: 亜衣がちらちら振りかえりながら、俺に苦い顔を向けて首を横に振る。“だめみたい”
lines.english: Ai kept glancing back at me, grimacing and shaking her head. *Looks like he can't.*

lines.japanese: 俺も頑として首を振りかえした。“だめじゃねえ、ぜってー来させろ”
lines.english: I shook my own head back, adamant. *Yes, he can. Make damn sure he comes.*

lines.japanese: しかし亜衣は電話の向こうに遠慮ばかりしていて話が進まない。いや、むしろ話はいまにも終わりそうだ。
lines.english: But Ai only kept deferring to the person on the other end, and the conversation went nowhere. In fact, it sounded moments away from ending.

lines.japanese: 「貸せ」
lines.english: “Give me that.”

lines.japanese: 俺は亜衣が背中を向けた拍子に手を伸ばして、やつの手から強引にケータイを引っこぬいた。
lines.english: The instant Ai turned her back, I reached out and yanked the phone from her hand.

lines.japanese: 「もし。あー森里。悪いけどソッコー、ヘテロ来てくれる」
lines.english: “Hey. Morisato. Sorry, but get over to Hetero right now.”
“...Narita?”

lines.japanese: 一瞬というには少し長い沈黙のあと、電話の向こうで眉をひそめたような反応があった。
lines.english: After a silence just too long to call momentary, Morisato answered in a voice I could almost hear frowning.

lines.japanese: 「……なんでおまえが亜衣の電話に出てんだよ」
lines.english: “...Why are you answering Ai's phone?”

lines.japanese: 驚きとは違う、静かな声だった。俺は質問を無視した。
lines.english: His voice was quiet, not surprised. I ignored the question.

lines.japanese: 「おう、知ってるか、Ｒ－ウィングの大司教が暴走してんの。だから。いま亜衣ひとりで帰したら、巻きこまれるかもしんねえだろ。おまえ、迎えに来てやれ」
lines.english: “Yeah. You know R-Wing's Archbishop has gone off the rails? That's why. If Ai goes home alone, she might get caught up in it. Come get her.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　うちはタクシー会社か？　ハイヤー呼びたいんだったら、最寄りの営業所にでもお願いしろよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What, do I run a cab company? If you need a chauffeured car, call the nearest depot.”

lines.japanese: 「ようハゲ。俺じゃねえぞ、女のために来いっつってんだぞ」
lines.english: “Listen, baldy. I'm not asking you to come for me. I'm telling you to come for a girl.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいよ隼人君、カズ君忙しいんだから。私、ひとりで帰れるってば」
lines.english: “I-it's okay, Hayato. Kazu's busy. I can get home by myself.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせ、殊勝なこと言ってるトキじゃねンだよ。実際もう、ふたりやられてんだよ」
lines.english: Shut up. Now's not the time for that noble crap. Two people are already down.

lines.japanese: ケータイを取りもどそうと詰めよってきた亜衣の言葉が、電話の向こうにも届いたんだろう。森里は短く言った。
lines.english: Ai had closed in to take back her phone, and her words must have carried to the other end. Morisato answered curtly.

lines.japanese: 「分かったよ。ヘテロだな」
lines.english: “Fine. Hetero, right?”

lines.japanese: そして電話は切れた。俺は赤いボタンを押して、ケータイを持ち主に返した。
lines.english: Then the call went dead. I pressed the red button and returned the phone to its owner.

lines.japanese: それから、しょぼくれる亜衣を連れて階段を下った。
lines.english: Then I led a dejected Ai down the stairs.

lines.japanese: フロアは薄暗く、そして静まりかえっていた。そこには、音の波に心地よく揺られるべきクラウドもいなかった。
lines.english: The floor was dim and utterly silent. No crowd swayed on waves of music.

lines.japanese: うごめく有象無象で埋めつくされていたときは手狭に思えた小さな箱が、いまは廃業した零細企業の事務所みたいに広く見える。
lines.english: The little room had seemed cramped when it was packed wall to wall with the writhing rabble. Now it looked as spacious as the abandoned office of a failed small business.

lines.japanese: カウンターの内側に、することもなく突っ立っているサイケＴシャツの店員がふたり。客は三人──俺と亜衣と鳳だけだった。
lines.english: Two employees in psychedelic T-shirts stood idle behind the counter. There were only three customers: Ai, Ohtori, and me.

lines.japanese: 入ってくるとき、ドアの外に「ＣＬＯＳＥＤ」の札がかかっていたのを俺は見ていた。
lines.english: On my way in, I had seen the CLOSED sign hanging outside the door.

lines.japanese: フロアの照明はほとんど落とされていて、レーザーもストロボもスクリーンも、みな忘れさられたように沈黙している。カウンターの上から降る柔らかな明かりだけが、店内の陰影を控えめに浮かびあがらせていた。
lines.english: Almost all the floor lights were down. Lasers, strobes, screens—everything stood silent, as though forgotten. Only the soft glow above the counter picked out the room in muted relief.

lines.japanese: 椅子はいくらでも空いてたけど、俺はなんとなく隅の床に直接ケツを下ろして片あぐらをかいていた。
lines.english: There were empty chairs everywhere, but for no particular reason I had planted my ass on the floor in one corner and sat with one leg folded in.

lines.japanese: 立てた片膝の上で頬杖をつき、鳳から渡された名刺大の紙片にときおり目を落として時が経つのを待った。
lines.english: I propped my cheek on my raised knee and waited, occasionally glancing at the business-card-sized slip Ohtori had given me.

lines.japanese: 暗がりの底ではほとんど見えないけれど、そこには１０桁の数字が並んでいるはずだった。
lines.english: I could barely see it in the darkness, but ten digits should have been printed there.

lines.japanese: そう、鳳は約束通り、妹のポケベルを呼びだすための電話番号を調べてきた。次は俺が約束を守る番──すなわち、やつが語るという話に耳を傾ける番だ。
lines.english: True to his word, Ohtori had found the telephone number for paging his sister. Now it was my turn to honor our bargain—to hear the story he meant to tell.

lines.japanese: だがやつは、ひと払いが済むまでその話は始めないと言って亜衣に冷めた一瞥を残し、ＤＪブースに引きこもってしまった。
lines.english: But he had said he wouldn't begin until everyone else was gone. He left Ai with a cool glance and shut himself in the DJ booth.

lines.japanese: その話……。
lines.english: That story...

lines.japanese: ゆうべは「その話」とやらを受けとめる行為が、わけもなく気重に感じられた。いまもそれは変わらない。病院の待合室で名前が呼ばれるのを待っている気分だ。
lines.english: The night before, the mere prospect of hearing this “story” of his had filled me with an inexplicable heaviness. That had not changed. I felt as if I were in a hospital, waiting for my name to be called.

lines.japanese: しかし、そんなことよりも、あいつからオウムに関する何かを聞きだせはしないだろうか。それこそ、やつのテル番でも住所でもいい──
lines.english: More pressing, though, was whether I could pry something out of him about the parrot. A phone number, an address—anything would do.

lines.japanese: 高い窓を見上げると、密閉型のごついヘッドホンに挟まれたアッシュゴールドの頭が、点から点へつつつと滑っては固まり、滑っては固まりを繰りかえしていた。まるで下手糞なロボットダンスだ。
lines.english: I looked up at the high window. An ash-gold head clamped in bulky closed-back headphones slid from point to point, froze, slid again, froze again. Like a terrible robot dance.

lines.japanese: 妙なノリ方をするやつ。楽園へ連れていってくれるという不思議な切手が、あいつの聴覚受容器に入ってくる音を魅惑的に歪めているのだろうか。どうでもいい。超どうでもいい。
lines.english: What a weird way to ride the beat. Maybe that mysterious stamp promising a trip to paradise was seductively warping the sound entering his auditory receptors. Whatever. Super whatever.

lines.japanese: 静寂の中、やがて地階への階段を下りてくるかすかな足音が俺たちの耳に届いた。
lines.english: Before long, faint footsteps descending the basement stairs reached us through the silence.

lines.japanese: 落ちつきなく隅のスツールに縮こまっていた亜衣の頭が、待ちかねたように動いた。俺も出入り口の方へ目を移した。
lines.english: Ai had been huddled restlessly on a stool in the corner. At once, she snapped her head toward the entrance as though she had been waiting for those footsteps. I looked too.

lines.japanese: 森里の仏頂面がコインロッカーを背景にうっすら見えた。
lines.english: Morisato's sullen face appeared faintly against the coin lockers.

lines.japanese: やつはまっすぐ女の席へ向かった、亜衣は軽い手荷物をまとめて腰をあげた、俺はとくに理由がないから立たなかった。
lines.english: He went straight to the girl's seat. Ai gathered her few belongings and stood. Having no particular reason to stand myself, I didn't.

lines.japanese: 「あー、はは……ごめんねカズくん、なんかテスト中に面倒かけちゃって……」
lines.english: “Ah, ha ha... Sorry, Kazu. You're in the middle of exams, and I've gone and made you come all this way...”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まあ、べつに」
lines.english: “Nah. It's fine.”

lines.japanese: 森里は拗ねたような口ぶりだった。
lines.english: Morisato sounded sulky.

lines.japanese: 「いいけど、なんでおまえここ来てんだよ。今日は来んなって、翔さんにも言われてたろ」
lines.english: “Fine, but why are you here? Kakeru told you not to come today, didn't he?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そうなんだけど、ちょっと隼人君に話があって……」
lines.english: “Yeah, but I needed to talk to Hayato about something...”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なんの話」
lines.english: “Huh? What about?”

lines.japanese: 「まー、ね……も、いいんだそれは」
lines.english: “Oh, you know... Never mind. It doesn't matter now.”

lines.japanese: 「よくねーだろ。俺、パシられっぱなしかよ。来てやったんだから聞く権利くらいあんじゃねーの」
lines.english: “It matters to me. What am I, your errand boy? I came all this way. Don't I at least get to hear it?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そお？　べつに、面白い話じゃないけど、うん、そしたら帰り道にでも……」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah? It's nothing interesting, but... sure, I'll tell you on the way home or something.”

lines.japanese: 「ね、とりあえず出ようよ。うちら、たぶん空気読めてないよ。翔さんややギレしてるし、隼人君は完璧シリアスモード入っちゃってるし」
lines.english: “Come on, let's get out of here first. I think we're failing to read the room. Kakeru's getting kind of pissed, and Hayato's gone into total serious mode.”

lines.japanese: 「あー。じゃー俺、いちおー翔さんに挨拶だけしてくるわ。来んな言われてんのに来ちゃったし」
lines.english: “Yeah. I'll at least go say hi to Kakeru first. He told me not to come, and I came anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: 一度立ちあがった亜衣だったが、勢いよくケツをソファーへ戻した。地べたの俺からは、スカートが浮きあがった拍子に丈の短いスパッツが見えた。クラブ仕様で踊るつもりだったのかもしれない。
lines.english: Ai had stood up, but she dropped briskly back onto the sofa. From my place on the floor, I glimpsed the short, close-fitting shorts under her skirt when it lifted. Maybe she had planned to dance tonight.

lines.japanese: 森里がちらりとも目を動かさずに、俺の横を通りすぎていった。やつが何も言ってこなかったから、俺も口を開けなかった。
lines.english: Morisato passed beside me without so much as a glance. He said nothing, so neither did I.

lines.japanese: 森里は丁寧なノックをしてから（たぶん中には聞こえてないだろう）ＤＪブースへ入っていった。俺は暗がりの中で、ふたたび手元の紙片に目を凝らした。
lines.english: Morisato knocked politely—though it probably could not be heard inside—then entered the DJ booth. In the darkness, I peered down at the slip of paper again.

lines.japanese: 疲弊したうつろな思考で、母を騙った娘へのメッセージをぼんやり考えてみる──
lines.english: With my thoughts hollowed out by exhaustion, I idly considered what message to send the girl while pretending to be her mother—

lines.japanese: ──それは現実から目を側める行為でもあった。誰かとくだらない世間話をする気力はなかったけれど、頭を空っぽにするのもどこか恐かったからだ。
lines.english: —which was also a way of looking away from reality. I had no energy for pointless small talk, yet the thought of emptying my mind frightened me too.

lines.japanese: 忘れて久しい──しかしずっと影のように俺のもとを離れることはなかったあの感情が、ひとたび息を吹きかえせば、たちまちすべてを呑みこんでしまいそうで恐かったからだ。
lines.english: That emotion had long lain forgotten, yet had never left my side, following me like a shadow. I was afraid that once it drew breath again, it would swallow everything whole.

lines.japanese: 事実、気付けば俺の頭の中はプラチナやマルチネスや糞ったれな女装男の顔・顔・顔が占拠していて、知らず左手の紙片を握りつぶしていた。
lines.english: And sure enough, before I knew it, my head was overrun with faces—Platinum, Martinez, that goddamn cross-dressing bastard. Faces, faces, faces. Unconsciously, I had crushed the slip in my left hand.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth.*

lines.japanese: 俺は肩を落として大きく息を吹いた。それから無意識のうちに破りすててしまわないよう、メモをフライトジャケットのポケットへ押しこんだ。
lines.english: My shoulders sagged as I blew out a long breath. Then I stuffed the note into my flight jacket so I wouldn’t tear it up without thinking.

lines.japanese: それから気を逸らすものを探して、あの高い窓を見上げた。鳳がヘッドホンを首へ落として立ちあがっていた。何かを見下ろしながら口を動かしている。森里の姿は見えなかった。
lines.english: Casting about for a distraction, I looked up at the high window. Ohtori had dropped the headphones around his neck and risen. His lips moved as he looked down at something. Morisato was nowhere in sight.

lines.japanese: 鳳はふいと首を巡らし、ふたたび椅子に戻ってヘッドホンをかけ直した。まぶたを閉じて音の波に浸かると、また灰色の頭を点から点へ、滑らせては固まり滑らせては固まりを繰りかえしはじめた。
lines.english: Ohtori abruptly turned his head, sat back down, and replaced the headphones. Eyes closed, he immersed himself in the waves of sound, and once again his head began sliding from point to point—freezing, sliding, freezing.

lines.japanese: ややあって、四角い窓の底辺から森里の姿が浮上した。やつは右手で口元を拭うと、すでに自分の世界に篭ってしまったあるじに深々と頭を下げた。
lines.english: After a moment, Morisato rose into view from below the square window. He wiped his mouth with his right hand, then bowed deeply to the room's master, already withdrawn into a world of his own.

lines.japanese: そしてブースから足早に退室し、俯きがちにフロアを横切ってゆく。闇に目を凝らすと、唇の端が切れて赤いものが滲んでいるのが見えた。まぶたに翳った目も、よく見れば赤かったのかもしれない。
lines.english: Then he hurried out of the booth and crossed the floor with his head lowered. Peering into the dark, I saw blood welling at the split corner of his mouth. Looking closer, I thought his shadowed eyes might have been red too.

lines.japanese: やつがまた白々しく目の前を素通りして行こうとしたとき、俺も白々しく膝を伸ばして足を投げだした。
lines.english: He made a great show of walking straight past me, so I made an equally great show of stretching out my knee and throwing my leg across his path.

lines.japanese: 森里は行く手を阻んだその障害物を見下ろして、静かに立ちどまった。しかしその体は正面を向いたままで、俺へ顔を向けようとはしなかった。
lines.english: Morisato looked down at the obstacle in his way and quietly stopped. He kept his body facing forward and made no attempt to turn his face toward me.

lines.japanese: 「悪かったな。勉強中」
lines.english: “Sorry for dragging you away from studying.”

lines.japanese: やつは答えなかったが、ラジオ体操の一節みたいにゆっくり首をこちらへ回した。
lines.english: He did not answer, but slowly turned his neck toward me like one measured count in the morning radio calisthenics.

lines.japanese: カウンターからの頼りない薄明かりを背にして、長髪の下のふたつの目がうつろに俺を見下ろしている。俺は目を逸らさずにその視線を受けとめた。
lines.english: With the feeble counter light behind him, two vacant eyes beneath his long hair looked down at me. I met them without looking away.
“Haaah...”

lines.japanese: やがて、やつは思いだしたように切れた唇の端を親指でひと撫でした。
lines.english: At length, as though just remembering it was there, he ran his thumb once over the split corner of his mouth.

lines.japanese: 「おまえは俺から、なんもかんも持ってっちゃうんだな」
lines.english: “You take everything from me, don't you?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 何を言ってるのかは意味不明だが──笑っていた。森里和馬がしばしば見せるあの表情。
lines.english: I did not know what he meant. But he was smiling—the same expression Kazuma Morisato so often wore.

lines.japanese: 俺はふとタカシのことを思いだした。ひとは成長するにつれて泣いてはいけないと教わるから、体の大きな子供は涙を我慢するとつい笑顔になってしまうんだ。
lines.english: I suddenly remembered Takashi. As people grow up, they are taught not to cry. So when a child in a grown man's body holds his tears back, he finds himself smiling instead.

lines.japanese: 「きっちーなあ。せめて居場所ぐらい残しといてくれよ」
lines.english: “Man, this is rough. Couldn't you at least leave me somewhere to belong?”

lines.japanese: 「なんのこと」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「はァ～あ、しょせん俺は小物だよ。言っても半端モンだ。誰かみてえに罪の意識なくひとを裏切るとか、そんなん出来ねえんだ」
lines.english: “Haaah. I'm small-time, that's all. A half-baked nobody. I can't betray someone without feeling guilty, like some people can.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、なんのことだって」
lines.english: “I'm asking what you're talking about.”

lines.japanese: 「なんでもいい。もう、なんもかんも、どうでもいいよ」
lines.english: “Whatever. None of it matters anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁぁ、めんどくせー、めんどくせー。生きんの面倒だし、死ぬのは恐ええし、もカンペキ手詰まりだわ」
lines.english: “God, what a pain. What a goddamn pain. Living's a chore, dying's terrifying, and now I've got no moves left.”

lines.japanese: 「おい森里──」
lines.english: “Hey, Morisato—”

lines.japanese: 俺は呼びとめたが、やつは俺の足を蹴散らして前へ──闇の向こうへ消えてしまった。
lines.english: I called after him, but he kicked my leg aside and vanished ahead, into the darkness.

lines.japanese: その先でやつを迎える亜衣の声がした。俺は息を吐きだしながら伸ばした足を引きよせ、その場に座りなおした。
lines.english: From the darkness ahead came Ai’s voice greeting him. I exhaled, pulled my outstretched leg back, and settled onto the floor again.

lines.japanese: やつらが店を出ていくと、窓の向こうで鳳はヘッドホンをむしり取って投げすてた。
lines.english: Once they had left the club, I saw Ohtori through the window tear off his headphones and fling them aside.

lines.japanese: 席を立ち、俺に向かってあの狂気めいた笑いを見せる。横へ振りぬいた顎が、いつもの別室へ行けと命じていた。
lines.english: He stood and turned that same mad smile on me. A sideways jerk of his chin ordered me into the usual back room.

lines.japanese: 俺は嘆息しながら腰をあげ、のろのろとＶＩＰルームへ向かった。
lines.english: I got to my feet with a sigh and trudged toward the VIP room.
